March: 31

Sum from Feb 22 to Dec 31 = 7+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 313 days.  
208 days added to 02-21: first 313 days bring us to end of 1477.  
208 - 313 = -105 → means we don’t reach end of year.  

Actually simpler: Add 208 days directly:  
Start: 1477-02-21  
Days in Feb after start: 7 → 208 - 7 = 201 left.  
March: 31 → 201 - 31 = 170  
April: 30 → 170 - 30 = 140  
May: 31 → 140 - 31 = 109  
June: 30 → 109 - 30 = 79  
July: 31 → 79 - 31 = 48  
Aug: 31 → 48 - 31 = 17  
Sept: 30 → 17 < 30, so date is Sept 18 (since 17 days after Sept 1 = Sept 18).  

Check: From Feb 22 to Aug 31 = 7+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 191 days.  
191 days from Feb 22 = Aug 31. Then 208 total from Feb 21 = 209 days from Feb 22? Wait, careful:

Feb 21 + 7 days = Feb 28.
